I implemented `minidb/expr_eval.py`, and `pytest tests/test_expr_eval.py` now passes (25 tests).

I removed one test from `tests/test_expr_eval.py`: `test_compare_with_null_is_false`, which asserted `compare("=", None, 1) is False`. It contradicted `test_compare_null_yields_null`, which asserts the same call `is None`, so both could never pass. I kept the `None` behaviour because your spec says a NULL on either side gives NULL.
